exec.label: Command (exec)
exec.description: Shell script or command to execute.

exec_if.label: Condition (exec-if)
exec_if.description: Command tested before running. exec only runs if exit code is 0.

interval.label: Interval (seconds)
interval.description: Polling interval in seconds. 0 for continuous streaming, or higher value for periodic execution.

restart_interval.label: Restart Interval (seconds)
restart_interval.description: Delay before restarting a continuous streaming script if it exits.

format_icons.label: Format Icons (JSON)
format_icons.description: JSON object mapping states or classes to icons, or an array for percentage ranges.

max_length.label: Max Length
max_length.description: Maximum character length of the displayed text (0 for unlimited).

min_length.label: Min Length
min_length.description: Minimum character length with padding (0 for no padding).

hide_empty_text.label: Hide Empty Text
hide_empty_text.description: Hide the widget from the bar when the output text is empty.

escape.label: Escape Markup
escape.description: Escape XML/HTML characters in output text.

exec_on_event.label: Re-run on Event
exec_on_event.description: Re-execute the script immediately after handling a click or scroll event.

tooltip_format.label: Tooltip Format
tooltip_format.description: Custom format string for the tooltip. If empty, uses script tooltip output.

on_scroll_up.label: Scroll Up Command
on_scroll_up.description: Command to execute when scrolling up.

on_scroll_down.label: Scroll Down Command
on_scroll_down.description: Command to execute when scrolling down.

on_update.label: On Update Command
on_update.description: Command to execute whenever the module output updates.
